title: An Invitation to a Friend
description: Practise invitations, plans and polite questions, then write an invitation to a friend.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 💌 Would you ___ to come to my house on Saturday?
exercises.explanation: "Would you like to ...?" is a polite invitation.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: We ___ going to have a barbecue in the garden.
exercises.explanation: Use are going to with we.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Can you come to my party?
exercises.explanation: Can + subject + base verb: Can you come?

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: The party starts ___ half past four.
exercises.explanation: Use "at" with clock times.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days: on Sunday.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: Do you want to watch a film with us?
answers: Would you like to watch a film with us?
exercises.explanation: "Would you like to ...?" is a polite way to ask.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I'm sorry, I can't come. I ___ be at my grandma's house.
exercises.explanation: Use "will" for a future fact or plan.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: My friend Nam, ___ lives next door, is coming too.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" for a person.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: You should bring your swimming costume.
exercises.explanation: Subject + should + base verb + object.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: If it rains, we ___ stay inside.
exercises.explanation: If + present simple, then will + base verb.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I have bought a present yesterday for you.
answers: I bought a present for you yesterday.
exercises.explanation: With "yesterday" use the past simple: bought.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Have you ever ___ to a sleepover? (be)
exercises.explanation: Use have + ever + past participle: been.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: ___ you tell me your address, please?
exercises.explanation: "Could you ...?" is a polite request.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: I plan to invite ten friends.
answers: I am going to invite ten friends.
I'm going to invite ten friends.
exercises.explanation: Use am going to + base verb for a plan.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: When you phoned, I ___ making sandwiches.
exercises.explanation: Use was with I in the past continuous.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I want to come but I can't.
I can't come but I want to.
exercises.explanation: Join two ideas with "but".

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: The party is ___ my house, next to the park.
exercises.explanation: Use "at" with a house or an address.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Use "your" before a noun.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: Tell me if you can come.
answers: Tell me whether you can come.
exercises.explanation: "Whether" can replace "if" here.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: I'm not sure about Saturday. I ___ have to help my mum.
exercises.explanation: "Might" shows it is possible.

task.prompt: You are having a party. Write an invitation to your friend.
contentPoints: Say what the party is for.
Give the day, time and place.
Say what you are going to do.
usefulLanguage: Would you like to come to ...?
Please tell me if you can come.
task.modelAnswer:
Dear Hoa,

Would you like to come to my birthday party? It is on Saturday at four o'clock at my house. We are going to play games, watch a funny film and eat pizza. You should bring your swimming costume because we might swim in the garden.

Please tell me if you can come.

Love,
Nam
